rubric.prompt: Assess every whole practice question individually on the MathsMap 0–100 cognitive-demand scale for a prepared student taught the relevant methods. Foundation 0–24: direct application; Development 25–49: routine linked procedures; Mastery 50–79: non-trivial connections or reframing; Challenge 80–100: decisive unsignposted insight. No quota or distribution. Read the student task first, then use the solution to detect hidden demand. Count decisions, representation changes and interpretation, not repeated parts, arithmetic bulk or solution length. Account for scaffolding actually supplied. Rate a multipart task by its hardest essential demand, not its average. Fractional numbers alone do not raise the band. Return an integer reasoningScore and a concise, task-specific difficultyReason explaining the decisions required. Never infer a score from an old band, title, page number or default. Do not change skills, content, answers or layout. If essential diagram/task evidence is unavailable, return a blocker rather than guessing.

task.instruction: Assess this exact whole owner, including the adjacent supplied worked example and the four-significant-figure instruction. Evaluate the student-facing task first; use its supplied answer only to identify hidden demand. Return one integer score and concise task-specific rationale.
